description: Block-level expression-matched permutation tests and target-gene position in the genome-wide effect-size distribution
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Expression-matched permutation results computed on the locked GSE299627 DE table.
blocks = [
 ("fibrillin + LTBP\n(n=6)",            -0.721, 0.0002, "#2b6cb0"),
 ("SR calcium handling\n(n=9)",         -0.817, 0.0003, "#dd6b20"),
 ("sarcolemmal entry\n(competing, n=5)",-0.088, 0.6477, "#38a169"),
 ("proliferation markers\n(n=8)",       -0.489, 0.0003, "#805ad5"),
 ("myoblast identity\n(n=4)",           -0.551, 0.0048, "#718096"),
]
# target genes: log2FC and percentile of |log2FC| genome-wide
tg = pd.DataFrame([
 ("RYR1",-7.585,99.6),("CASQ2",-5.301,98.7),("TRPC3",-2.205,95.0),("ATP2A3",-1.429,91.2),
 ("LTBP3",-1.317,90.2),("FBN1",-1.200,89.0),("ITPR1",-0.965,85.4),("ATP2A1",-0.817,82.0),
 ("LTBP2",-0.739,79.7),("LTBP4",-0.702,78.4),("TRPC1",0.629,75.5),("LTBP1",0.528,70.2),
 ("DMD",-0.431,63.3),("ZNF277",0.406,61.3),("CALM2",0.368,57.7),("FBN2",-0.358,56.8),
 ("CALM1",0.284,48.4),("PIEZO1",-0.257,44.6),("CALM3",-0.227,40.3),("ORAI1",0.161,29.7),
 ("ATP2A2",-0.151,28.0),("STIM1",-0.088,17.0)], columns=["gene","log2fc","pct"])

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13.5, 5.4), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1,1.15]})

ax = axes[0]
y = np.arange(len(blocks))
ax.barh(y, [b[1] for b in blocks], color=[b[3] for b in blocks], edgecolor="black", lw=0.4)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([b[0] for b in blocks], fontsize=9)
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.axvline(0, color="black", lw=0.8)
for i,b in enumerate(blocks):
    ax.text(b[1]-0.03, i, f"p={b[2]:.4f}", va="center", ha="right", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(-1.05, 0.25)
ax.set_xlabel("median log2 fold change of the block, DMD vs healthy")
ax.set_title("Expression-matched permutation test\n(background drawn from the same baseMean deciles, 20,000 draws)", fontsize=10)

ax = axes[1]
cols = []
for g in tg.gene:
    if g in ("FBN1","FBN2"): cols.append("#2b6cb0")
    elif g.startswith("LTBP"): cols.append("#63b3ed")
    elif g in ("ATP2A1","ATP2A2","ATP2A3","CASQ2","CALM1","CALM2","CALM3","RYR1","ITPR1"): cols.append("#dd6b20")
    elif g in ("ORAI1","STIM1","TRPC1","TRPC3","PIEZO1"): cols.append("#38a169")
    else: cols.append("#718096")
ax.scatter(tg.log2fc, tg.pct, c=cols, s=55, edgecolor="black", lw=0.4, zorder=3)
for _, r in tg.iterrows():
    ax.annotate(r.gene, (r.log2fc, r.pct), textcoords="offset points", xytext=(5,3), fontsize=7.5)
ax.axhline(50, color="grey", ls=":", lw=1)
ax.text(-7.4, 51.5, "median gene genome-wide", fontsize=8, color="grey")
ax.set_xlabel("log2 fold change, DMD vs healthy")
ax.set_ylabel("percentile of |log2FC| among all 17,977 tested genes")
ax.set_title("Half the target genes move less than the median gene.\nATP2A2 and STIM1 sit in the bottom third of the distribution.", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
